name: Kadokura Youko
source:
Youko is in the same grade as [url=/c10806]Kimie[/url], she the student council's vice-president at the school and has a cool personality. 
She becomes the student council vice-president, or the president, depends on the route. She is called "Mikado no Kimi" in the third grade.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
